title: A curated multi-endpoint drug-protein bioactivity dataset with construct-aware protein targets
abstract: arXiv:2610.32490v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public drug-protein bioactivity resources commonly identify targets by UniProt accession, although one accession may represent distinct experimental sequences. We present Curate-DTI, a construct-aware dataset derived from the 1 July 2026 BindingDB export, with IC50, Ki, Kd and EC50 processed independently. The release contains 2,919,717 measurements, 1,291,872 standardized ligands, 9,668 sequence-defined protein entities and 2,275,683 endpoint-specific interactions spanning 8,336 reviewed UniProt accessions. Protein entities combine the accession with the reported experimental sequence, preserving constructs that accession-only processing would merge. Across the four endpoints, 4,204 endpoint-specific ligand-accession groups showed different classification labels across sequence-defined protein entities. Exact and inequality-qualified observations provide relation-aware classification evidence, whereas regression targets use exact values

translated_title: 一个具有构建体感知蛋白靶点的精选多终点药物-蛋白质生物活性数据集
translated_abstract: 公共的药物-蛋白质生物活性资源通常通过UniProt登录号来识别靶点，但一个登录号可能代表不同的实验序列。我们提出了Curate-DTI，这是一个构建体感知的数据集，源自2026年7月1日的BindingDB导出数据，其中IC50、Ki、Kd和EC50被独立处理。该数据集包含2,919,717条测量数据、1,291,872个标准化配体、9,668个序列定义的蛋白质实体，以及涵盖8,336个已审核UniProt登录号的2,275,683个终点特异性相互作用。蛋白质实体将登录号与报告的实验序列相结合，保留了在仅按登录号处理时会被合并的构建体。在四个终点中，共有4,204个终点特异性的配体-登录号组在不同的序列定义蛋白质实体间显示出不同的分类标签。精确值和不等式限定的观测值提供了关系感知的分类证据，而回归目标则使用精确值。
tldr: 该论文构建了Curate-DTI数据集，通过将UniProt登录号与实验序列结合来区分不同的蛋白质构建体，提供了包含超过290万条测量数据的构建体感知多终点药物-蛋白质生物活性数据集。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Curate-DTI, a construct-aware multi-endpoint drug-protein bioactivity dataset that distinguishes protein constructs by combining UniProt accessions with experimental sequences, containing over 2.9 million measurements.
